paragraphs.text:
Two foreigners stand on deck. The tall fellow wears a robe with 
a cowl. He is perhaps Arabic or Turkish. A shorter fellow, ferret-
like, looks in your direction. Though they seem out of place on 
this ship, they make you feel uncomfortable. Move on a day 
and go to 187. 
(73, 83)
